title: Terrapin Soup (Tekénősbékaleves)
description: Prepared with broth, sour cream, and bread.
steps: Cut off the heads, feet and tails of three or four terrapins
Scald, remove the meat, cut finely and cook in salted water
Place butter and finely chopped green parsley in a pot
Braise the terrapin well in this
Sprinkle with a little flour and pour as much pea broth as needed over it
Add a little black pepper, nutmeg flower and two tablespoons of sour cream
Cook slightly more and serve on fried bread

title: Theakészítés más módon (Tea Preparation - Alternative Method)
description: A tea preparation using pekoe or souchong and hot water.
steps: A világos úgynevezett pecco theából több, a sötét (souchong) theából kevesebb veendő egy-egy csészére
A gyengébb theából nem tetés kávés kanálnyi, az erősebből fél kanállal egy-egy csészére
Ha 4–10–15 csésze thea készül egyszerre, akkor nem kell 4–10–15 külön adagra való theát venni, hanem elégséges 3–7–11 külön adagra való mennyiség
A víz teljesen tiszta, zsiradékmentes edényben forralandó
Mihelyt buzogva forr, a thea-kannában levő theára gyorsan reá öntendő
Befedendő, és azonnal servirozandó
A theának a szerint, a milyen ereje van, 1½–2–3–4, sőt a zöld theáknál 5 perczig kell a leforrázás után állani
Ha három csészénél több töltendő meg, akkor a sorba rakott csészék előbb balról jobbfelé töltessenek meg félig
Aztán folytatólagosan jobbról-balra lesz a theás csésze teletöltve

title: Tiroli kenyér (Tyrolean Bread)
description: A bread preparation made with ground almonds, juice, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: juice and finely chopped zest of 1/2 orange
ingredients.sourceText: juice and finely chopped zest of 1/2 orange

steps: Work 28 dekagrams of softened butter, the same amount of blanched and ground almonds, the same amount of imperial flour, 14 dekagrams of sifted sugar, 1 dekagram of anise, the juice and finely chopped zest of 1/2 orange, 5 egg yolks, and a little genuine Tokay wine into a smooth dough in a mixing bowl
Knead lightly by hand on a board for a while longer
Roll the dough into thin layers
Fold in half three times, then roll out again to knife-blade thickness
Cut into equal boat shapes
Place on butter-coated sheet metal and bake at gentle heat until light golden
When cooled, brush with fine apricot marmalade and place another on top so that the two lower parts of the boats are joined by the apricot marmalade

title: Tiroli rétes (Tyrolean Strudel)
description: Prepared with dough, almonds, and orange.

ingredients.name: peel of 1 orange and 1 lemon, finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: peel of 1 orange and 1 lemon, finely chopped

steps: Prepare buttered dough and stretch it long, like dough for noodles
Finely grind 28 decagrams plumped almonds and 28 decagrams sugar
Finely chop the peel of 1 orange and 1 lemon
Place everything in a bowl, add 2 whole eggs and 4 egg yolks
Beat for half an hour until well fluffy
Pour onto the buttered dough and spread with a knife
Sprinkle with 10 decagrams finely chopped candied lemon
Fold gently together
Place on a buttered parchment paper
Brush with egg white
Bake in strong heat

title: Tisztított czukortorta (Refined Sugar Cake)
description: A cake made with sugar, almonds, and quince.

ingredients.name: 28 dekagrams blanched and finely chopped almonds
ingredients.sourceText: 28 dekagrams blanched and finely chopped almonds

steps: Cook sugar and water together in a copper pan until clarified
When the sugar has cooked enough to begin to thread, add the blanched and finely chopped almonds, citronade, quince marmalade, preserved walnuts, and lemon zest
Stir until it begins to harden
Place the whisked mixture on a wafer-lined cake base
Cool, sprinkle with powdered sugar, and decorate with preserved fruit

title: Tojás rákleves (Egg Crayfish Soup)
description: A soup made with egg, rice, and veal.

ingredients.name: 1/4 kilo veal lung stewed and finely chopped
ingredients.sourceText: 1/4 kilo veal lung stewed and finely chopped

ingredients.name: 1/8 kilo salted bacon cut into tiny cubes
ingredients.sourceText: 1/8 kilo salted bacon cut into tiny cubes

ingredients.name: ground black pepper and clove pepper abundantly
ingredients.sourceText: ground black pepper and clove pepper abundantly

steps: Clean the eggshells nicely

Prepare the filling: for 20 eggshells mix 1/4 kilo stewed rice, 1/4 kilo veal lung stewed and finely chopped, 1/8 kilo salted bacon cut into tiny cubes, ground black and clove pepper abundantly, one head onion finely chopped, green parsley, one whole raw egg, little saffron and nutmeg flower
Mix these together well
Fill the eggshells very firmly with the filling
Place in a pan with the openings facing upward
Pour hot water over them and cook until soft
Make a thin red roux
Pour abundant sweet sour cream over the soup
The fine egg crayfish soup is ready

title: Tojás Vagdalékkal (Poached Eggs with Vegetable and Fish Ragout)
description: Prepared with eggs, pike, and asparagus.

ingredients.name: piece of pike cooked in salted water
ingredients.sourceText: piece of pike cooked in salted water

steps: Cook pike in salted water, remove bones, and chop finely
Cook 18 asparagus spears in salted water
Stew finely chopped mushrooms with green parsley
Cook and peel a few crayfish tails
Chop everything into small cubes and sauté in melted butter
Add salt, a few tablespoons sour cream, and stew well
Carefully pour 8 eggs into boiling salted water so they stay whole
Cook only until they begin to set, but do not let them harden
Serve the ragout piled high in the middle of the plate
Arrange the eggs around it in a wreath shape, lifting them out with a slotted spoon

title: Tojás-sodralék (Egg Roll with Vegetables and Fish)
description: A bread preparation made with mushrooms, pike, and asparagus.
steps: Beat 10 eggs in a pan and salt them
Melt butter in a pancake pan and add a small portion of the beaten eggs
Let it spread in the pan and cook like a pancake; repeat until all egg is used
Prepare the filling: stew finely chopped mushrooms with butter and green parsley
Chop the fried, deboned pike into small pieces
Cook asparagus in salted water and cut into oblong pieces
Chop 20 crayfish tails and claws into cubes
Make a mixture from 3 eggs and beat it finely
Add all of this to the stewed mushrooms
Add a few tablespoons sour cream and stew slightly
When the egg pancakes are cooked, fill them with the mixture and fold them together
Cut off the edges and cut in the middle and divide
Arrange the egg rolls neatly on a dish greased with crayfish butter, with 2-3 tablespoons sour cream poured in
Salt slightly
Pour another tablespoon of sour cream on top
Decorate with crayfish tails
Place in the oven, let it heat through for a few minutes, and serve quickly

description: Prepared with batter, crayfish, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: half a roll soaked in milk
ingredients.sourceText: half a roll soaked in milk

steps: Prepare pancakes and set aside
Make a batter from four eggs
Shell and clean fifteen crayfish tails and claws
Coarsely chop the crayfish, the bread soaked in milk, and mushrooms that have been braised in butter with green parsley
Cream butter with several tablespoons of sour cream
Mix in the chopped ingredients
Spread the filling on the pancakes and place on a plate
Add sour cream and butter on top, place hot coals above, and brown lightly

title: Tojáspohárka (Egg Cups)
description: Prepared with bread, crayfish, and sour cream.
steps: Hard-boil twelve eggs and peel them
Cut off the top and bottom to make lids
Hollow out the yolks without breaking the whites
Chop the yolks and cut lids finely with bread soaked in milk
Crush several crayfish tails, crayfish butter, and three whole eggs with salt in a mortar
Mix with six tablespoons of sour cream
Fill the egg whites with this mixture
For the sauce: dice mushrooms and cut cooked good quality fish into small cubes
Combine with green parsley, crayfish tails, and a little nutmeg
Braise lightly in crayfish butter
Place this mixture on a buttered plate
Stand the filled eggs on top
Pour two deciliters of sour cream over them
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and crayfish butter
Bake until golden brown

title: Tok frikasszirozva (Squash Fricassee)
description: Prepared with squash, onion, and lemon rind.

ingredients.name: red onion head, divided into four parts
ingredients.sourceText: red onion head, divided into four parts

steps: Melt a piece of butter and fry a full spoon of flour in it until golden
Add the red onion head divided into four parts and lemon rind
Fill with pea water and cook until done

Before serving, beat two egg yolks in a pot, strain the sauce over them, place on coals, stir constantly until it begins to thicken
Pour it over the plated squash and serve immediately

title: True Czibere Soup (Valódi czibere-leves)
description: Prepared with bread dough or yeast, bran, and rice.

ingredients.name: well-worked black bread dough made with yeast or sourdough
ingredients.sourceText: well-worked black bread dough made with yeast or sourdough

steps: From well-worked black bread dough made with yeast or sourdough, set aside about one liter
Let it rise in a slightly warm place for 6-8 hours
Place in an 8-9 liter earthenware pot and mix by hand with 2 liters of water
When well mixed, thicken with clean wheat bran to form a soft dough consistency
Cover with a lid and leave in a warm place for 48 hours, stirring three times daily with a wooden spoon
On the third day, fill the pot with cold water and let it settle for a couple of hours
When settled, strain off as much as needed into an earthenware pot and bring to a boil
For each liter of czibere, cook a handful of rice, and when tender, strain off the water
For each liter of czibere, beat an egg and egg yolk with a tablespoon of sour cream
Temper by first adding a small amount of hot czibere so it does not curdle, then add to the whole pot
Stir well, season with salt, add the cooked rice and bring to a boil
When boiling, add a tablespoon of melted butter per liter, and if not sour enough, a little cream of tartar
Pour into small bread cubes and serve
Serve oil at the table and those who like it can pour a spoonful into their bowl
Refill the pot with the same amount of clean water and keep in a warm place for later use
One starter can be strained eight times if kept in a good place

title: Tépett csuka savanyú káposztával (Shredded Pike with Sour Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, pike, and onion.
steps: Prepare the cabbage in the usual way, thicken it with a little red onion and cook it down with the sauce.
Scald the pike with salted water, remove its bones and tear it into small pieces.
Melt a little butter, add two heads of red onion cut into thin slices and brown it nicely to a golden colour.

On a plate, arrange several spoonfuls of sour cream, a little butter and one portion of the shredded pike, salt it, then add some of the browned onion, then again three or four spoonfuls of sour cream, one spoonful of breadcrumb, again some of the fish, and so on until everything is used up.
Pour the last layer with milk and braised onion, place several pieces of butter on the breadcrumb, put it in the oven and cook for a quarter hour, then serve to the table together with the cabbage.

description: Prepared with pike, onion, and anchovies.
steps: Clean the pike of scales and cut it in half along the back, removing all its meat along with the bones, but the head and tail must remain on the spine and the entire skin must remain intact.
Remove the bones from the meat and chop it finely with red onion, fresh parsley, and several anchovies cleaned of skin and bones.
Add grated bread soaked in milk and squeezed, a piece of butter, a little nutmeg, pepper, salt and three eggs, and mix until as smooth as dough.
Fill the pike's skin completely with this filling and sew it shut along the back.
Place the pike in a well-buttered pan and roast until a beautiful golden color, basting five or six times with fresh sour cream or butter during roasting.
Once roasted, place the fish upright on a plate and slice it beautifully and evenly with a sharp knife, pour the sauce over it and sprinkle evenly with thinly sliced lemon zest.
Pike can be prepared the same way, and if carp is to be used this way, only the sour cream and lemon zest should be omitted, so the fish should be basted during roasting only with melted butter.

title: Töltött cukorsuvegecsek rizsből (Filled Sugar-glazed Rice Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with rice, sugar, and cream.

ingredients.name: grated chocolate or sugar for coating
ingredients.sourceText: grated chocolate or sugar for coating

steps: Cook the rice in cream until soft
Add the finely ground almonds and sugar to taste
When the rice is soft, let it cool slightly
Place it on a board dusted with flour and flatten into triangular pieces with a knife
Fill each piece with canned apricot
Brush the edges with egg white and roll into a small sugar-glass shape
Dip in beaten egg, then in fine breadcrumbs
Fry in hot fat
When removed from fat, dip in grated chocolate or sugar
Heap high on the serving dish

title: Töltött czukorsüvegeskék rizsből (Filled Sugar-Glass Shapes with Rice)
description: Prepared with rice, sugar, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: seven dekagrams of finely crushed almonds
ingredients.sourceText: seven dekagrams of finely crushed almonds

steps: Cook twelve dekagrams of rice soft in seven deciliters of sour cream
Add seven dekagrams of finely crushed almonds and enough sugar to make it sufficiently sweet

With a knife, flatten into triangular pieces
Fill with preserved apricot
Brush the edge with egg white and roll it together in the shape of a small sugar-glass
Finally, dip into beaten egg and then into fine bread crumbs and fry in fat

title: Töltött fahéjas fánk (Filled Cinnamon Doughnut)
description: Prepared with cinnamon, egg yolks, and sour cream.
steps: On a board, work together twenty-eight dekagrams of butter, forty-two dekagrams of flour, and fourteen dekagrams of crushed sugar well with a rolling pin
Add three egg yolks and enough sweet sour cream so the dough achieves proper firmness
Work this finely with a wide knife, not by hand
Fold together and roll out three times as with butter dough
At the third rolling, roll half the dough slightly thicker than noodle dough and brush with preserved apricot
Roll out the other half of the dough in the same way and place it on top
Cut into rectangular sheets four fingers wide and tie them to a cinnamon doughnut tube with string
Fry in fat and sprinkle thickly with sugar and cinnamon

Note that the sheets should not be filled completely to the edges with preserve, so it does not run out during frying; it is better to first cut the sheets and then fill each one separately, brush the outer part with egg white, place the other sheet on top and press slightly along the edge

title: Töltött fehérpecsenye más módon (Stuffed Veal Breast, Another Way)
description: A stuffed meat preparation with bacon, hard-boiled egg, lemon peel and mace.
steps: Vegyünk 2 kiló, lehetőleg vastag fehérpecsenyét
Éles késsel vágjuk ki közepéből a húst
A gömbölyű pecsenye hártyás külső része, a mennyire lehetséges, vékony zacskóforma legyen
Az ebből kivágott pecsenyét tegyük deszkára és vagdaljuk jól meg
Továbbá aprítsunk még a pecsenye közé 10 deka fehér szalonnát és három keményre főtt tojást
Tegyünk a töltelékbe egy kávés kanál tört borsot, sót, kevés apróra vágott citromhéjat és egy késhegynyi tört szerecsendió-virágot
A tölteléket egy egész nyers tojással gyúrjuk jól össze
Tömjük meg vele a nyers fehérpecsenyezacskót
Ha teletömtük, varrjuk be czérnával a végét
A húst sózzuk meg és kevés borssal is hintsük be
Tegyük egy kanál zsírral együtt lábasba
Öntsünk még reá nehány kanál vizet
Gyakran megforgatva pároljuk egy óra hosszáig, hogy minden oldala piros legyen
Ha a külső hús puha, lehet tálalni
Szép, vékony szeletekbe vágjuk
Egymás mellé csínosan rakva, hosszú tálban szokás tálalni
Körítsük párolt vegyes zöldséggel

Thread them onto a spit
Roast slowly until golden brown

title: Töltött Kalarábi (Stuffed Kohlrabi)
description: Prepared with meat, onion, and goose fat.
steps: Cook the tender kohlrabi in salted water until half-cooked
Cut off a small lid from the top and hollow it out well
Chop cooked or braised meat, fresh parsley and a small piece of red onion finely
Melt a small spoonful of goose fat, fry a spoonful of flour in it
Add the chopped parsley and onion, brown lightly
Add the chopped veal meat, mix well
Pour a little broth over it and cook well
Fill the hollowed kohlrabi with this mixture
Place in the prepared butter sauce
Let simmer with frequent shaking for a quarter hour
Arrange neatly on the dish and serve

title: Töltött Kelkáposzta (Stuffed Kale)
description: Prepared with kale, veal, and duck liver.

ingredients.name: firm, tender, not too large kale heads
ingredients.sourceText: firm, tender, not too large kale heads

steps: Clean the kale heads and hollow them out carefully
Cook in salted water and drain the liquid completely
Place on a sieve to drain thoroughly
Prepare the stuffing: chop cooked or braised veal, fresh parsley, and a small piece of red onion finely
Melt a small spoonful of goose fat in a pan, fry a spoonful of flour in it
Add the chopped parsley and onion, brown lightly
Add the chopped veal, mix well
Pour a little broth over it and boil well
Beat two eggs and add them while stirring continuously until a thick mass forms
Cool the mixture
Form this into a thick sausage shape
Separate the cabbage leaves and place the sausage inside
Arrange the leaves neatly so it forms a kale head again
Tie with twine and place in the prepared sauce
At serving time, cut the heads in half and place neatly on the dish
Pour the sauce over them and serve with fried veal feet

title: Töltött pisztráng (Stuffed Trout)
description: Prepared with trout, pike, and onion.
steps: Remove the entrails from the trout, clean it and salt it, then let it stand for a while.
Take a piece of pike, carefully remove its bones, and chop it finely with a small red onion, milk-soaked and squeezed-out half bread roll, a little lemon zest and fresh parsley.
Add salt and ground pepper to the mixture, beat one or two eggs into it and mix everything well.
Dry the trout with a cloth, spread the filling on it, coat with melted butter, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, place in a buttered baking pan.
Put in the oven, baste several times with butter so they acquire a nice color.
Place on a buttered plate, pour a little sour cream over it and simmer slightly.

title: Töltött rostélyos (Stuffed Roasted Beef)
description: Prepared with beef, onion, and sour cream.
steps: Remove the fat and bones from the roasted beef, beat it well with the flat of a knife, and salt it
Chop one slice of roasted beef finely and mix it with green parsley, red onion, and lemon zest, and salt it
Mix this filling with sour cream so that it can be spread well
Spread this filling on a piece of roasted beef to the thickness of a knife spine
Place another piece of roasted beef on top, fasten it in four places, and do the same with the rest
Place a pot with a few slices of bacon, red onion, thyme, and bay leaves and line the bottom
Place the roasted beef pieces in the pot with several peppercorns and clove pepper, braise until tender, and serve
Cook the sauce until golden, sprinkle a spoonful of flour on top, brown it, add a spoonful of liquid and several spoonfuls of sour cream
Strain it over the roasted beef and cook once more

title: Tört leves (Broken Soup)
description: A soup made with pike, broth, and breadcrumbs.
steps: Prepare the soup the same way as on meat days, but instead of chicken use a large pike head, and instead of meat broth use pea water.
Serve the soup with pike dumplings prepared as follows: Cook a nice piece of pike, about one kilogram, in salted water.
Clean the pike from bones and skin.
Chop two pieces of breadcrumbs soaked in milk and pressed out, three beaten eggs, and chopped green parsley finely together.
Beat seven dekagrams of butter until fluffy.
Add the chopped mixture to the butter and mix well.
Add one whole egg and three egg yolks, mix everything well.
Season with a little salt.
Do not knead the dough too firmly.
Shape small dumplings, roll them in fine breadcrumbs, and fry them.

title: Török tej-kocsonya (Turkish Milk Jelly)
description: Prepared with cream, apricot or raspberry or marmalade, and almond.

ingredients.name: A few drops of almond liqueur (if using raspberry)
ingredients.sourceText: A few drops of almond liqueur (if using raspberry)

steps: Set seven deciliters of good heavy cream on ice in a brass pan and whip it with a whisk until the entire mass becomes stiff foam
In a pan, beat five tablespoons of apricot or raspberry marmalade with fourteen dekagrams of finely broken sugar until frothy
If using raspberry, add a few drops of almond liqueur to give it a pale pink color
Gently and slowly mix the foam with this mixture
Add the dissolved and cooled isinglass
Bury the mold in ice, pour in the mixture, and freeze on ice
For serving, top the foam with Spanish fritters or close with a wreath made from and dried puff pastry

title: Törött Rizsabroncs Vajastésztában (Broken Rice Puffs in Butter Dough)
description: Prepared with rice, butter, and cream.
steps: Grind 7 dekagrams of cleaned rice very finely.
Heat butter in a pan, add the rice and fry, then pour 4 deciliters cream over it and stir until thick.
If too thick, add more cream; it should have the consistency of a soufflé.
Add vanilla sugar to taste.
Remove from heat, beat in 3 egg yolks until frothy, then slowly fold in the stiffly beaten whites of 3 eggs.
Line round molds with butter puff pastry, add a good spoonful of mixture, top with a little apricot preserve, then fill completely with the remaining mixture.
Place in the oven and bake slowly.

title: Túró-fánkocska (Cottage Cheese Fritters)
description: Prepared with cottage cheese, puff pastry, and egg white.

ingredients.name: Cottage cheese (enough to fill a small coffee cup), finely grated
ingredients.sourceText: Cottage cheese (enough to fill a small coffee cup), finely grated

steps: Prepare puff pastry and fold it three times, then roll out to knife-thickness
Cut out medium-sized rounds with a donut cutter and place on a baking sheet
Brush the centers with egg white
Cut smaller rounds with a slightly smaller cutter (small enough to fit inside the first) and place them on top of the first rounds
Beat seven dekagrams butter until light, then add egg yolks one at a time
Mix in the finely grated cottage cheese, season lightly with salt, and blend in {{source-6}}; the mixture should be thick, not thin
Using a knife dipped in sour cream, form the filling into pointed mounds on the centers of the fritters
Cut rounds from the second set of pastry pieces using the same smaller cutter, then cut out a small center with an even smaller cutter to create a crown shape
Place the crown on top of the cottage cheese mound to partially enclose it
Brush the pastry with egg white and bake until a beautiful light golden color

title: Túró-lepény (Cheese Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with lard or butter, yeast, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: one egg-sized piece of clarified butter
ingredients.sourceText: one egg-sized piece of clarified butter

steps: Take {{source-0}} and 3/8 its weight in lard or butter, rub well together
Dissolve {{source-2}} in half a coffee cup milk with 3 pieces of sugar
Mix the yeast mixture with 4 egg yolks, half a coffee cup wine, salt, and quickly knead into a soft dough—if kneaded too long it becomes tough and not crumbly
Let rest for several hours until visibly risen
Flatten to knife-blade thickness on a baking sheet
Press cottage cheese through thick cloth to remove whey, then place in a bowl
Mix the pressed cheese with 2 egg yolks, a few tablespoons of sour cream, one egg-sized piece of clarified butter, and whipped egg white, adding a pinch of salt
Spread the cheese mixture finger-thick over the dough on the baking sheet, sprinkle with flour and butter generously over the flour so a beautiful brown crust forms on top while the cheese stays soft
Fold the edges of the dough back onto the sheet about a finger's width and press with your fingers to create a decorative border
Brush the folded edge with egg and bake at high heat until beautifully browned

Place in the oven and bake until nicely golden

title: Uborkát becsinálni (Preserved Cucumbers)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, walnut, and seeds.
steps: Place medium-sized cucumbers, preferably small rather than large, in fresh water and leave them there for 2-3 hours, pouring fresh water over them several times
Drain them, place on cloth, and dry them
The barrels in which you place them must be very clean
Put a walnut-sized piece of alum in each barrel and the usual herbs: currant leaves, cucumber herb, and especially a lot of ironwort, as this preserves the firmness and green color of the fruit
After lining the bottom of the barrel with this, place a good layer of cucumbers on top, then herbs again, then cucumbers, and so on until the barrel is full
Boil equal parts vinegar and good white wine with several handfuls of salt, three dekagrams of whole pepper, and three dekagrams of white ginger in a clean earthenware pot
Pour this mixture hot over the cucumbers, then seal tightly immediately
Check occasionally, and if there is barrel mold on top, remove it; if necessary, pour a little more wine and vinegar
Shake this container several times during use

For households where only small quantities of cucumbers are needed, it is better to preserve them in glass jars rather than barrels; the procedure remains the same, except that the jar, since the vinegar is not absorbed, should be tied tightly closed with paper and a bladder and stored in a dry place like cooked fruit

title: Vadpecsenyeként páczolt őzderék (Marinated Venison Roast)
description: Prepared with venison, vinegar, and peppercorns.
steps: Remove the outer membrane from the venison with a knife and place in a bowl
In a pot, combine {{source-1}}, {{source-2}}, 2 tin spoons salt, 1 spoon peppercorns, 6 bay leaves, 1 large onion, and 6 cloves
Bring the mixture to a boil and cook for a quarter hour
Pour the hot brine over the venison in the bowl while hot
Cover and place in a cool location
Turn the meat in the brine twice daily
The meat can be cooked after just one day, but keep longer if possible
When ready to roast, place on a board and lard with thin bacon slices along the spine in four rows and on the sides
Place in a roasting pan and pour 1 liter of strained brine over it
Roast in a hot oven for one hour, basting several times
In a bowl, combine 1 tin spoon flour with 2 decilitres sour cream and mix together
Pour this mixture into the roasting liquid and simmer for a few minutes
Cut the venison with a sharp knife across the backbone so the bone is severed in each slice
Arrange in a long dish, garnish with lemon slices, and pour the sauce underneath

title: Vagdalék Barna Abroncsban (Forcemeat in Brown Ring Mold)
description: Prepared with veal, bacon, and carrots.
steps: Braise {{source-0}} with bacon slices, carrots, cloves, and onion, occasionally adding good stock, until nicely browned
Remove the meat and chop finely
Soak half a bread roll in brown stock, squeeze out, and add to meat
Pound the mixture with 5 egg yolks in a mortar until it becomes a paste
Place in a pot, add a little brown stock and lemon juice and a little glace, cook well until it resembles a purée
Pass through a sieve
Butter a ring mold and fill it with this mixture
Braise in a water bath for three-quarters of an hour
Meanwhile, cut cooked veal sweetbread and roasted veal into cubes, include crayfish tails, asparagus or artichokes in small pieces, some sliced button mushrooms, and finely chopped parsley
Braise this garnish mixture in butter and cook well
Turn out the brown ring mold onto a serving dish
Fill the center opening with the garnish mixture
Alternate crayfish tails, asparagus tips, and artichoke rosettes around the ring for service

Braise for one hour
Turn out onto a serving dish and garnish with marrow carbonate

Can be surrounded with a crown made of butter pastry

Cut out a round or rectangular piece and brush the outer edge with egg white to one finger's width

For round pastry: cut small donut-sized pieces and arrange them on the edge of the pastry, overlapping so the second piece always covers half of the first

Quickly extract the dough that spreads between the two pieces
Fill the pastry with the prepared filling

Carefully fill the pastry with the filling using a spoon
Replace the lid and serve on the table
Alternative: the pastry can also be filled with rabbit or venison instead

title: Vajastorta őszibaraczkkal (Butter Cake with Peaches)
description: A cake made with butter, peaches, and puff pastry.
steps: Prepare puff pastry dough and work it as described in the previous recipe, rolling it to little finger thickness
Cut out a leaf with a warm knife, then cut a smaller leaf from it such that the first has a border two fingers wide
Stretch the smaller piece so it matches the crown in size
Place on a butter-coated pastry leaf and brush the edge with egg white as far as the crown requires, then place the crown on top, doing this with great care to maintain the round shape
Peel 24 beautiful peaches and cut them in half
Coat one half with finely crushed sugar and line the bottom of the cake all the way to the crown with these pieces
Bake in a moderately cooled oven for half an hour
If the ring has risen high, sprinkle it with fine sugar on top and all around and glaze it to a red-golden color with good flame fire which is kindled in one corner of the oven for this purpose
Cook the other half of the peaches in a syrup made from 140 grams of sugar until it is jelly-thick
Arrange the peaches neatly in the cake and when serving, pour the syrup over it

title: Vajastészta (Butter Pastry)
description: A pastry dish made with sour cream, vinegar or wine, and flour.

ingredients.name: white vinegar or 2 tablespoons wine
ingredients.sourceText: 1 tablespoon white vinegar or 2 tablespoons wine

steps: Salt the flour on the kneading board
Beat in an egg, two tablespoons of sour cream, and one tablespoon of white vinegar or two tablespoons of wine
Add a little water if not wet enough; the dough should be somewhat stiffer than ordinary strudel dough
Knead until it separates from the hand, then form into a round loaf
Continue kneading while shaping
Cover with a cloth and let rest for fifteen minutes
Roll out to the thickness of a knife blade
Knead 28 dekagrams of butter well and form into a wide sheet
Place this in the middle of the dough
Fold the dough over it from all four sides
Dust the board lightly with flour
Beat the dough with a rolling pin and stretch as thin as possible
Fold in four parts on the same side and brush off the flour
Use minimal flour when dusting to prevent sticking
Roll lightly and let rest for fifteen minutes in a cool place (in hot weather place between two plates on ice)
Roll out again
Repeat this process three times; the fourth time shape as desired

title: Vegyes Kompót (Mixed Compote)
description: Prepared with cherries, lemon juice, and pears.
steps: Stew large white cherries in sugared water and lemon juice
Remove the stems from large sour cherries and stew them separately in water and sugar
Peel small pears that ripen at the same time and stew them separately in water and sugar without stems
When soft, add a spoonful of rum to them, simmer for a few more minutes and cool
Boil 9 decagrams of sugar with a cup of water until the sugar begins to thread
Clean 5 large peaches, cut them in half, remove the pits, dip them in the sugar, and boil until the sugar coats them completely, being careful they do not fall apart

When serving the compote, place the white cherries in the center of the dish, piled high, arrange the sour cherries in a wreath around the cherries, arrange the peaches around this, and finally the small pears, which are left whole, and to keep them beautifully white, brush them with lemon juice after peeling; these form the outer wreath, arranged so their stems point upward

title: Vegyes Kompót Más Módon (Mixed Compote Another Way)
description: Prepared with pears, lemon juice, and peaches.
steps: Cook larger pears such as emperor pears, peel them, cut them in half, and stew them with water, sugar, and lemon juice
Boil 10 decagrams of sugar with a coffee cup of water until it threads, peel 5 large autumn peaches, cut them in half, and add them, being careful they do not overcook but remain whole
Cook 4 deciliters of serviceberries in water with enough sugar for sweetness
Peel the zest from 2 oranges and cut it into long strips, boil this in water until soft

In a pan, boil 9 decagrams of sugar with a little water until it threads, drain the orange zest, and with a fork dip it carefully in the thickened sugar so it does not break, bring to a boil for a moment and cool

When serving, make the first wreath from the pears, the second from the peaches, pile the serviceberries in the middle, place the orange zest on the edge of the pears, and if well set, stand it up straight with a fork

Finally, mix a coffee cup of good vanilla liqueur with half a cup of water, a little sugar, and 1.5 decagrams dissolved isinglass, strain this through cheesecloth, freeze it well, and when set, turn it out and cut small half-moons from it, arranging these on the compote in neat order

title: Vegyes tejhab (Mixed Cream Foam)
description: Prepared with cream, raspberry, and egg white.
steps: Place 1 liter of good heavy cream in a large brass preserving basin, set on ice or cool in a good cellar
Beat with a whip until the entire mass becomes thick foam
Divide into three parts
Leave the first part white and add enough ground sugar and vanilla to make it sufficiently sweet
Mix the second part quickly with freshly pressed raspberry juice, 10 dekagrams finely ground sugar, and a little egg white

Mix the third part with strong, previously cooled black coffee and enough sugar to make it sufficiently sweet (2-3 tablespoons of coffee with a third of the foam is enough to give it the proper brown color and good coffee flavor)
Dissolve isinglass, strain it, cool it, and divide it among the three parts
Pour the coffee foam first into a round mold or basin and set on ice
While the first is freezing, place the other two foams in a cool place
When the first has frozen, pour the red foam on top, freeze again, and finally add the white foam
Before serving, dip the mold briefly in warm water and carefully turn the foam out onto a plate

title: Vert élesztős tészta (Beaten Yeast Dough)
description: Prepared with yeast, cream, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: preserved apricots, currants or poppy seeds for filling
ingredients.sourceText: preserved apricots, currants or poppy seeds for filling

steps: Divide the flour into two parts
From the larger part, prepare dough on a board with cream, egg yolks, dissolved yeast, sugar and salt; this dough should be firmer than puff pastry
Knead it with your hand until it separates from the hand, form into a ball and set aside covered with a cloth

Salt the other half of the flour, place firm butter in the middle, cover with flour and smooth with a rolling pin until the flour and butter are completely mixed, being careful not to touch the butter but always separating it with a wide knife and stretching it into a long strip
When done, place the dough on a board dusted with flour, roll out to the thickness of two knife-backs, place the butter in the middle and fold the dough over it from all four sides
Roll out and fold together four times like puff pastry
Note that this dough should not rest but should be rolled out and folded quickly one after another
This dough is especially good for pot pies and yeast cake, but particularly for rolls: roll out to knife-back thickness, cut out round leaves with a large cutter and brush the edges with egg white
Fill with preserved apricot, currants or poppy seeds, fold together and form into roll shapes
Place on a baking sheet and let rise slightly
In the meantime, blanch almonds, dry and chop finely and mix with an equal amount of ground sugar
When the rolls have risen, brush with egg yolk, sprinkle thickly with the almond sugar and when baked, sprinkle again with sugar and serve on the table

title: White Turnip (Fehérrépa)
description: Prepared with turnips, broth, and ham.
steps: Peel the young white turnips, wash them and cut each into five or six equal parts shaped like crescents
These slices should be the length and thickness of a small finger
In melted butter brown two spoonfuls of crushed sugar until golden
Add the turnips and when they are well mixed with the sugar, pour half a serving spoon of brown broth over them
Shake well and braise until the turnips are soft but do not fall apart
Finally add a serving spoon of glace and cook this into a large sauce
Turn the turnips on all sides, pour the little sauce into a plate, arrange the turnips on it in triple wreath form with a fork, and garnish the edge of the plate with finely chopped ham

description: Prepared with white wine, egg yolks, and sour cream.
steps: Mix one liter of good white wine with three deciliters of water so it is not too strong

Beat six egg yolks in a pot and add three full tablespoons of sweet sour cream

Quickly bring the soup to the table so the bread does not soften

title: Zsemle-pudding Bor-sodóval (Roll Pudding with Wine Sauce)
description: A sauce made with rolls, almonds, and raisins.

ingredients.name: fourteen dekagrams of raisins and small dried grapes
ingredients.sourceText: fourteen dekagrams of raisins and small dried grapes

ingredients.name: two whole eggs and four egg yolks
ingredients.sourceText: two whole eggs and four egg yolks

steps: Soak the grated peel of two rolls in milk
Crush ten dekagrams of soaked almonds
Clean fourteen dekagrams of raisins and small dried grapes
Beat seven dekagrams of butter until fluffy
Squeeze the rolls well, chop finely and add to the butter
Add two whole eggs and four egg yolks one after another and stir for a quarter hour
Fold in the stiff whites of three eggs
Add the almonds, raisins and small grapes
Add a piece of sugar rubbed with citron or orange peel and mix well
Line a pot with butter, cut a white paper to fit the bottom and butter it
Arrange attractively with raisins and soaked almonds on the bottom
Add the pudding mixture and cook in steam for one hour
Turn the pudding onto a plate and carefully remove the paper
Pour the prepared wine sauce around it
For the sauce: crush sugar rubbed with citron, put in a pot with ten egg yolks, mix with twenty tablespoons of good white wine and place over glowing coals
Stir the sauce continuously until it thickens and rises, then remove quickly from the fire and pour onto the plate

title: Zöld Mandolát Befőzni (Preserved Green Almonds)
description: Prepared with almonds, vinegar, and sugar.

ingredients.name: almonds equal in quantity to the sugar
ingredients.sourceText: almonds equal in quantity to the sugar

steps: Preserve almonds when their kernel is still soft. For half kilogram of sugar, take an equal amount of almonds. Clean them with cloth so the coarse part comes off. Cook them in one part white vinegar and two parts water until they can easily be pierced with a pin, then place on a sieve to dry. Cook the sugar with one glass of water until it threads, then cook the almonds in it for a quarter hour, turning them with a silver spoon on all sides so they absorb the sugar well. Remove them and cook the syrup a bit longer. Place the almonds in jars, pour the slightly cooled syrup over them, leave the jars open, and for four days every twenty-four hours bring the syrup to a boil. On the fifth day, when the preserve is completely cool, seal the jars.

title: Zöld paszulyt (babot) télre megtartani (Preserved Green Beans for Winter)
description: Prepared with beans, vinegar, and beef fat or butter.
steps: Clean the tender beans by removing the strings
Bring water to a boil in a pot and add the beans
Cook for a short quarter hour, then drain quickly and place in cold water
When completely cooled, remove and spread on clean cloth to dry
When dry, place in an earthenware pot
Take two parts water and one part white vinegar with fourteen dekagrams salt per two liters
Boil the beans only a few times so they don't become too soft
Boil the water only until the salt is completely dissolved, then remove from heat
When cooled, pour over the beans
Pour melted fresh beef fat or butter over it so that the fat forms a hard protective layer that air cannot penetrate
When the fat has hardened, tie the pots closed and store in a cool place
When using, take out as much as needed and place in lukewarm water an hour before use
Close the pot with freshly melted lard, otherwise the rest would spoil

title: Ászpikot készíteni (Aspic)
description: Prepared with pork, veal, and vegetables.

ingredients.name: fresh pork skin, cleaned of all fat
ingredients.sourceText: 1 kilogram fresh pork skin, cleaned of all fat

ingredients.name: vegetables: root vegetables, red onion, carrot, kohlrabi, 2 heads white cabbage
ingredients.sourceText: vegetables: root vegetables, red onion, carrot, kohlrabi, 2 heads white cabbage

steps: Rinse the pork skin several times in warm water and clean it of all fat
Place it in a pot with a piece of veal knuckle, pour {{source-2}} over it, add salt and vegetables
Clean off the scum frequently and simmer until half-cooked, then refill the pot with warm water
Continue boiling until the skins are so soft they can be pressed apart and the aspic is reduced to about 1.5 liters
In a separate pan, sauté sliced bacon, 1 kilogram soup meat, red onion, carrot, kohlrabi, and 2 heads white cabbage, all cut into slices, with several peppercorns and cloves
Cover and braise, stirring occasionally, until nicely browned without burning
Pour the liquid in which the skins were cooked into this, add 3-4 deciliters strong vinegar and any remaining pork skins not yet softened
Cook everything until reduced to about 1.5 liters
Beat 4 egg whites in a pot until foamy and beat in 1 whole egg with its shell
Pour the previously strained, fat-free, warm aspic into the eggs and beat well with a whisk during pouring
Let it stand quietly in a warm place for three hours
Strain slowly and pass through a stretched cloth
If not completely clear, strain once more
Cool it in a cold place and use as desired for meat dishes, mayonnaise, or preparation of cold foods

title: Égő Pudding (Flaming Pudding)
description: A pudding made with rolls, cream, and ground almonds.

ingredients.name: one and one half grated rolls
ingredients.sourceText: one and one half grated rolls

ingredients.name: four and one half decilitres of good cream
ingredients.sourceText: four and one half decilitres of good cream

ingredients.name: seven dekagrams of soaked finely ground almonds

ingredients.name: three egg yolks and two whole eggs

ingredients.name: five dekagrams of citronât cut into large cubes
ingredients.sourceText: five dekagrams of citronât cut into large cubes

ingredients.name: preserved green walnuts, green plums, pitted cherries and cornelian cherries
ingredients.sourceText: preserved green walnuts, green plums, pitted cherries and cornelian cherries

steps: Pour four and one half decilitres of good cream over one and one half grated rolls
Add seven dekagrams of soaked finely ground almonds and enough sugar for sweetness
Cook to a paste with continuous stirring and cool
Mix in seven dekagrams of butter, three egg yolks and two whole eggs one after another
Add five dekagrams of citronât cut into large cubes, preserved green walnuts, green plums, pitted cherries and cornelian cherries in equal amounts and as much as so the roll is not overly noticeable
Finally fold in a little stiff white of three eggs
Put the pudding in a buttered ring mould and steam for one hour
Turn out when serving and at that moment fill the hollow in the pudding with good rum, add a few sugar lumps, set alight and serve quickly flaming
This paste is especially suitable for suppers
Arrange the bottom of the mould attractively with half-moon shaped citronât pieces and soaked almonds
Serve with orange juice sweetened with a little sugar or wine sauce

title: Élesztős írós-tészta (Yeast Butter Dough)
description: Prepared with yeast, butter, and flour.
steps: Mix together one kilogram fine flour, 6 whole eggs, {{source-2}}, {{source-3}}, and one teaspoon salt
Add enough warm (but not hot) milk so the dough is neither too stiff nor too soft
Knead well and let rise slightly
When the dough begins to spread, stretch with a rolling pin to about one finger-thickness
Brush with good butter
Fold in the four corners so that the four corners meet in the middle
Let rest again for 10-15 minutes
After rest, stretch again and brush with butter
Finally, after it rises slightly, stretch one more time to barely a finger-thickness
Cut short strips, barely one span long and two fingers wide from the dough
Each strip should be brushed with egg and sprinkled with almonds
Place curved butter dough on a baking sheet or flat pan and bake immediately at normal heat without rising, for this way it will be nicely layered

description: Prepared with lamb, onion, and bacon.

Chop green parsley, onion, and thyme finely, add pepper, and prepare strips of bacon, coating them in this mixture
Make holes in the leg with a sharp knife and lard it with bacon, then wrap it completely with thread so the bacon does not fall out
Place parsley, onion, and several peppercorns in a pot, add the leg, fill with brown broth, cover and braise until completely tender
Remove the leg, strain the sauce and boil it until only one or two spoonfuls remain
Return the leg to the sauce and turn it several times in the small amount of sauce
Chop six or seven onions coarsely, melt a piece of butter and place the onions in it with pepper, fry until golden
Sprinkle flour over and brown it, add several spoonfuls of broth so it does not burn, add another spoonful of broth and cook for half an hour longer
Place the sauce on the serving plate and the leg on top

title: Ürüczomb rizszsel (Lamb Leg with Rice)
description: Prepared with lamb, rice, and anchovy.
steps: Clean the leg thoroughly of its membrane, peel the meat from the bone, trim it slightly, salt it, make holes with a narrow knife and lard with anchovy that has been well soaked and cleaned of bones
Take equal quantities of thyme and marjoram, rub the leg well with these, place in a wooden vessel, cover with a fitted lid, place a stone on top and leave in a cool place throughout the whole day
The next day cook half kilogram rice in salted water until the grains burst
Cut 42 dekagrams bacon into fine slices and line the pot with it, place half the rice on it and cover the rice with bacon slices
Put the lid on the pot and seal it well with dough, braise for three hours at even heat and place a little coals on the lid
After three hours open the pot, remove the bacon, strain its fat and turn the whole thing out onto a large plate

title: Agurk Salat (Cucumber Salad)
description: A salad made with cucumbers, vinegar, and salt.
steps: Peel and cut into as thin slices as possible.
Place on a plate with a large pinch of salt between the slices and a fork placed over them.

Place in a dish and add vinegar and pepper.

title: Agurker (Pickled Cucumbers)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, grape, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: alum (a piece the size of a pea per 2 gallons)
ingredients.sourceText: alum (a piece the size of a pea per 2 gallons)

steps: Select small cucumbers no larger than a small finger. Pack them in a crock or stone jar with generous salt between the layers. Cover the top completely with salt and pour enough cold water over to cover the cucumbers. Place a plate over them and weight it down with a clean cloth to keep them submerged. They can stand in the brine for a whole month, stirring from the bottom every other day. After 48 hours, the cucumbers can be removed if desired.

To pickle: drain the brine and remove any soft cucumbers. Place the remaining cucumbers in fresh water for 24 hours, then change the water and let stand another 24 hours. Line the bottom of the pickling vessel with grape leaves and arrange the cucumbers on them, sprinkling powdered alum between the layers. Fill with cold water and cover with more grape leaves. Heat gently without boiling for 4-5 hours.

For the vinegar: to 1 gallon of cider vinegar add 1 cup sugar, 3 dozen black peppercorns, the same number of nutmegs, half as much allspice, and a little mace. Boil for 5 minutes. Pour the hot vinegar over the cucumbers in a stone crock. Cover with a plate. Two days later, reheat the vinegar and pour it over again. Repeat this process three times at intervals of 2, 4, and 6 days. Place a plate that fits inside the crock over the cucumbers and tie a cloth over the top. They can be eaten after 6 weeks.

title: Almond Porridge (Mandel-Grød)
description: Prepared with rice flour, blanched almonds, and milk.

ingredients.name: One half pound of rice flour
ingredients.sourceText: One half pound of rice flour

steps: Stir the flour into some of the cold milk, adding it bit by bit so it does not lump.
Place the rest on the fire.
When it boils, combine the unstirred flour with a bit of the warm milk and pour it into the porridge with strong stirring back and forth.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add finely sliced blanched almonds and salt at the end.
It is cooked in a good quarter hour and eaten with sugar, butter and cinnamon.
This porridge is particularly pleasant to eat cold; then use a little less milk and a few drops of vanilla.
Pour it into a mold, from which it is turned out and served with fruit juice over it.
As a warm porridge without butter and almonds it is good for children.

title: Appelsin Marmelade (Orange Marmalade)
description: A fruit preserve made with oranges and sugar.
steps: Peel the oranges and cut the peel into strips, and cook in three changes of water until tender; then set aside.

On the remaining oranges remove the peel; the inner white skin is taken off and discarded; all oranges are cut into 4 pieces and the seeds removed; then cut the fruit into very small pieces, and all the juice that comes from them, without pressing them, is poured over the sugar; this is heated until the sugar is melted, and if the fruit is not very juicy, add a very little water.
Cook and skim for five minutes; then add the cooked peel and cook another ten minutes and finally the diced fruit and clean peel, and the whole cooks now two minutes longer.
When it is cold, pour it into small glasses or pots, cover with brandy paper and seal.

title: Beef Heart (Hjertesoppa)
description: Prepared with beef, egg yolk, and onion.
steps: Wash the heart well and cut it into quarters, about an inch long, add water so it stands over the pieces and cook for ten minutes.
Salt the water a little to draw out the blood and skim very carefully as the scum rises.

Take out the heart and strain the soup, mince the heart finely and put it back in the soup with a sliced onion, a large tablespoon of catsup, minced parsley, a little minced celery root, a little cayenne pepper and a good lump of butter.
Cook now until the meat is very tender, then stir a tablespoon of flour into it, dissolved in a little cold water.
Let it boil up once and serve straight.

title: Beef Soup (Oxtail Soup)
description: A soup made with onions, celery, and bay leaves.
steps: Rinse the oxtails very well in cold water and let them stand for a while in fresh water.
Bring them to the boil slowly with even, uniform heat; skim well as they cook.
Remove the lid only when the soup foams.
Do not dilute the soup, but if necessary, add only boiling water after all has been removed.
Strain the soup through a fine sieve; if it is not very clear, place a cloth inside.
Let it cool slightly before straining; remove the fat and pour carefully back into the pot so the sediment does not come with it.
When the soup boils again, skim once more and remove all foam carefully.
The vegetables (small onions and celery roots) are best cooked separately in water or light soup so the soup remains clearer and does not lose flavor.
When serving, a piece of white sugar may be added for pleasant flavor.
This portion requires about 3 hours of cooking.

description: Prepared with beef, butter, and salt.
steps: The meat for beef steak should be a Porterhouse.
The sinew is cut from the sides; it is best to get a thick piece, which you then beat well.

When it is done, place it on a platter, lay cold butter and salt over it, and let it rest a moment in the oven.

title: Beef Tea (Beef Tea)
description: Prepared with beef and water.
steps: Chop the beef finely
Place it in 1 pint of cold water in a lined pot
Set over heat in the same water and bring slowly to a boil

title: Beste Marmelade (Best Marmalade)
description: A fruit preserve made with quinces, water, and sugar.

ingredients.name: Sugar (scant 1 pound sugar per 1 pound fruit)
ingredients.sourceText: Sugar (scant 1 pound sugar per 1 pound fruit)

ingredients.name: Apple juice (juice of 2 apples per 3 pounds fruit, optional)
ingredients.sourceText: Apple juice (juice of 2 apples per 3 pounds fruit, optional)

steps: Peel and slice the quinces into pieces with the stones removed; cook the peelings, stones and cores in scant water under a lid; when they have cooked long enough to draw out all the juice, strain the water through a thick cloth.
When this water is approximately cold, put the quinces in a clay pot and pour the water over them, and it cooks, stirring and mashing the fruit with a spoon, gradually as it becomes soft.
This gives a pleasant flavor if you add the juice of 2 apples to every 3 pounds of fruit.
When it is stirred to a soft pulp, stir in scant 1 pound of sugar for every pound of fruit; cook for another 10 minutes, stirring.
Then remove it, and when cold, put it in small jars or glasses with brandy paper over.

title: Blommer No. 1 (Plums Preserved No. 1)
description: Prepared with plums, vinegar, and sugar.

ingredients.name: Vinegar (half a gill per pound of plums)
ingredients.sourceText: Vinegar (half a gill per pound of plums)

ingredients.name: Sugar (3 ounces per pound of plums)
ingredients.sourceText: Sugar (3 ounces per pound of plums)

steps: The plums must be fully ripe
Dry them, prick with a pointed toothpick or needle and place in a crock
Pour over them half a gill vinegar per pound of plums and let stand until the next day

Pour off the vinegar onto the plums with 3 ounces sugar per pound, place on the fire, and when it is just melted, add the plums and turn them a couple of times around so those that were at the bottom come to the top

When it begins to boil, pour it into the crock, leave uncovered until the next day, pour it into another crock so the juice can come to all the plums, and the next day put the whole thing back on the fire, but remove it as soon as it begins to boil
Two days later set it back on the fire, and now cook the plums until they are not sour by the stones, usually in 1.5 hours; then place them in a sieve so the juice can drain off
Cook the juice a good quarter hour, or until it becomes thick, with whole cinnamon and cloves
Pour it into a crock and when it is cold, place the plums in it, though not too many, so there can be sufficient juice around them
Seal them the next day
If there is more juice than can be with the plums, pour this into bottles
If one wishes to use these plums for roasts, it is good to add some fresh currant leaves

title: Blommer No. 2 (Plums Preserved No. 2)
description: Prepared with plums, vinegar, and water.

ingredients.name: Plums (for each pound, take 0.75 pound sugar)
ingredients.sourceText: Plums (for each pound, take 0.75 pound sugar)

steps: For each pound of plums take 0.75 pound sugar, which is cooked on the fire with 0.5 gill vinegar and 1 tablespoon water; when it is melted, pour it over the plums, which are first dried, pricked and placed in a crock

After 3-4 days, during which the plums are poured into another crock each day so the juice can come around them, place them over the fire where they cook until they are no longer sour by the stones, about 1.5 hours; then place them in a coarse sieve and from there in a crock, which is filled halfway with them
Cook the juice with cinnamon and cloves in a quarter hour or until it is thick
Pour it warm over the plums, which are sealed the next day
The plums can also be preserved in the same way with 0.75 pound sugar and 0.5 gill vinegar per pound, but then they have less juice

title: Boiled Trout with Oyster Sauce
description: A sauce made with trout, oysters, and egg yolk.
steps: Clean and boil the trout in salted water according to instructions.
Once the trout is done, remove the head from the fire and set it aside.
Meanwhile, set a pint of oysters over the fire to cook in their own sauce.
Once the oysters are cooked, strain the sauce and set it back over the fire to boil.
Melt one ounce of butter over the fire in a frying pan, stir in one ounce of flour.
Thicken the sauce with one beaten egg yolk, half a teaspoon of salt and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Add the oysters to the sauce and serve in a sauce bowl.

title: Boston Brown Bread
description: A bread preparation made with yeast, potatoes, and fat.

ingredients.name: 6 potatoes, mashed together with 3 cups flour
ingredients.sourceText: 6 potatoes, mashed together with 3 cups flour

steps: Make a dough consisting of: 2 cent compressed yeast, 6 potatoes mashed together with 3 cups flour, 1 quart warm water, {{source-3}} and {{source-4}}
Mix well and set overnight in a warm place
When light, sift in: 1 quart cornmeal, 2 quarts cornmeal, {{source-7}}, {{source-8}} and {{source-9}}
Mix to a very soft dough, adding more warm water gradually if needed
Knead well and let rise 6 to 7 hours
Knead again and divide into loaves, place in well greased, deep, round bread pans
Let rise again for about an hour in a warm place, then bake in a moderately warm oven for about 3 to 4 hours
If setting this in the oven early in the day when the kitchen is small, it can stay in the oven the whole night

title: Braised Calf's Breast (Blanguet af Kaltekød)
description: Prepared with white pepper, vegetables, and onion.
steps: Cut the calf's breast into small pieces and place in sufficient cold water to cover them; add half a teaspoon of white pepper, a teaspoon of salt, a good bunch of vegetables, half a scraped carrot, a peeled turnip and an onion in which 3 cloves are stuck.
Bring to a gentle boil and skim carefully as long as scum rises, and cook until the meat is tender; then strain it, return the soup to the fire and the meat is washed in cold water.

In the meantime make a white sauce by melting a little butter and stirring flour into it and gradually adding 1½ pints of the soup; add a little more pepper and salt if necessary, and half a teaspoon of grated nutmeg.
When the sauce has boiled up, thicken it with an egg white and two small egg yolks stirred in, add the meat and cook a couple of minutes while stirring occasionally.
It can be served with a tablespoon of minced parsley scattered over it after it has been placed on a warm dish.

title: Brown Bread Soup (Bread Soup)
description: A soup made with bread, celery, and beef stock.

ingredients.name: 1 small piece of sweet bread, about 1 pound by weight
ingredients.sourceText: 1 small piece of sweet bread, about 1 pound by weight

steps: Rinse the sweet bread and cook it in barely enough water together with 6 large pieces of celery until they easily fall apart.
Strain the whole mixture with beef stock, cook a little, rub through a colander, then through a sieve.
Set it back on the fire with some finely cut white carrots.
When it boils, place small beef balls on top.
In the absence of beef balls, the soup may be eaten with toasted bread.
Alternatively, brown a piece of butter in the pot, add 2 tablespoons full of finely cut carrots and 1 tablespoon of onion, and fry well until light brown.
Then add the soup gradually, simmer gently until the carrots fall apart, rub through a colander with more soup, finally through a sieve, and finish with cut white carrots and small beef balls.

title: Brown Cream Sauce (Brun Gløde Sauce)
description: A sauce made with egg yolk, cream, and butter.
steps: Take equal parts butter and egg yolk for brown sauce. The butter is browned in a pan and a tablespoon of flour is browned in it. This is made with a couple of tablespoons of egg yolk. When this boils, the cream is added and stirred hard until the sauce boils. If you have no egg yolk, then do not use flour either, but then the cream must be good. If it should happen that it separates, a little more cream is taken and if it becomes too thick from that, it is remedied with soda. This sauce is for veal and poultry and can also be used for beef, goose and duck. For poultry one should avoid soda.

Cook the sauce until it is perfectly smooth, and pour it over the quinces which are tied up the next day.

title: Calf's Foot Soup (Brown Calf's Foot Soup)
description: A soup made with carrots, parsnip, and onions.

ingredients.name: A small bunch of parsley and celery
ingredients.sourceText: A small bunch of parsley and celery

steps: Cut the cleaned calf's feet into pieces.
Melt 8 ounces of butter over the fire in a pot until well browned.
Add 2 large carrots, 1 parsnip, 3 onions, a small bunch of parsley and celery, a little thyme, and 3 bay leaves, all finely chopped, along with 1 tablespoon of whole pepper.
Brown the pepper carefully in the butter without burning it.
Simmer for 5 hours, then add 1 pint of water.
After this has cooked a while, dilute gradually with 5 pints of water.
Add the calf's foot pieces with salt and simmer under cover with regular stirring until the meat is so tender it can easily be removed from the bones with a spoon.
Remove the pieces and pour them warm into the tureen while the soup is strained and finished with good stock and optionally 1 pint of wine or rum.
If the upper parts of the feet are too large to be in the tureen, cut the meat from the bones and add it to the tureen.

title: Canned Green-Corn (Konservert Majs)
description: Prepared with corn, fat, and salt.
steps: Remove the leaves and boil the corn until no milky juice comes out when you prick the kernels.

Cut the kernels off and pack them in stone crocks in the following order: 3 pounds, one bag salt, one half gallon of dill, then one bag corn, two gallons of dill, and so on until the crock is nearly full.
The topmost layer should be one gallon of salt, and over the whole pour melted fat (not lard).
Press a bag of clean white paper that fits the crock on top, and bind the crock with paper or better with a pig's bladder.
Store in a cold place.
Soak overnight before use.
If the top layer should become moldy, which may happen, not all the corn is affected, and you only need to remove this layer.

title: Cherry Soup (Kirsebærssuppe)
description: Prepared with cherries, bread or rolls, and water.
steps: Stone and cook {{source-0}} with 1 quart water, drain, cook again with 1 pint water and strain into the first drained soup.
To clarify the soup, you can place a clean cloth in the sieve and pour the soup through it, after which it is returned to heat with whole cinnamon, cloves and sugar to achieve a good flavor.

title: Chicken (Høn)
description: Prepared with chicken, peppercorns, and carrot.
steps: When the chicken is cleaned, cut it up; remove the wings and legs first; separate the breast and back, and cut these into suitable pieces.

Place them over boiling water in boiling broth, which should cover them. Skim as often as foam rises, then add a tablespoon of salt, a handful of peppercorns, a carrot, an onion, a couple of parsley sprigs, and a bay leaf.
Simmer gently until the chicken is tender, approximately one hour, then remove it and keep it warm while the broth is strained.

The broth is strained and set back over the chicken to simmer; a piece of butter and an ounce of flour are stirred together over the fire; little by little, part of the broth is stirred in, adding a beaten egg and stirring until the sauce is smooth. Salt and pepper are added, and it is served on a warm dish.

title: Conserve of Melon or Cucumber
description: Prepared with cucumbers or melons, sugar, and ginger.

ingredients.name: Large cucumbers or small melons, still whole and green
ingredients.sourceText: Large cucumbers or small melons, still whole and green

steps: Large cucumbers or whole small melons, both still quite green, are cut into large pieces, about an inch in width and half as thick, are rinsed, placed on a clean cloth to dry. The outer skin should remain on, where it is not on the cucumber too thick and hard.

Finely pounded loaf sugar is mixed with as much vinegar as it can dissolve; it is cooked until it is skimmed and clear, with 1 teaspoon of pounded ginger for each 2 pounds. Now the pieces get a good boil in the sugar, after which they are taken up, placed in a crock, and the sauce is poured lukewarm over. Should it not cover, then more must be cooked.

As the pieces tend to float up, they are pressed down with a spoon or a small round object, which is placed in the crock with something heavy on it. After 3 days they are taken up, to place the top pieces at the bottom. When they have stayed thus so that one can taste that they are thoroughly penetrated by the sugar, they are taken up and placed in a dry crock or a thick wood, and sprinkled between each day with dry loaf sugar.

This also becomes syrup, and both this and the first can be used to fill other cucumbers. The conserve pieces are now placed in layers in a press with paper above and below. When they are pressed, a string is drawn through them and they are allowed to hang in an airy place to dry, but not in the sun. Finally they are stored in a crock with soft white sugar between each layer. The fruit must not be allowed to dry too much.

sourceIngredients: Large cucumbers or small melons, still whole and green
sourceSteps: Large cucumbers or whole small melons, both still quite green, are cut into large pieces, about an inch in width and half as thick, are rinsed, placed on a clean cloth to dry. The outer skin should remain on, where it is not on the cucumber too thick and hard.

Finely pounded loaf sugar is mixed with as much vinegar as it can dissolve; it is cooked until it is skimmed and clear, with 1 teaspoon of pounded ginger for each 2 pounds. Now the pieces get a good boil in the sugar, after which they are taken up, placed in a crock, and the sauce is poured lukewarm over. Should it not cover, then more must be cooked.

As the pieces tend to float up, they are pressed down with a spoon or a small round object, which is placed in the crock with something heavy on it. After 3 days they are taken up, to place the top pieces at the bottom. When they have stayed thus so that one can taste that they are thoroughly penetrated by the sugar, they are taken up and placed in a dry crock or a thick wood, and sprinkled between each day with dry loaf sugar.

This also becomes syrup, and both this and the first can be used to fill other cucumbers. The conserve pieces are now placed in layers in a press with paper above and below. When they are pressed, a string is drawn through them and they are allowed to hang in an airy place to dry, but not in the sun. Finally they are stored in a crock with soft white sugar between each layer. The fruit must not be allowed to dry too much.

title: Druer (Grapes)
description: Prepared with grapes and brown sugar.

ingredients.name: half pound of the same sort of grapes
ingredients.sourceText: half pound of the same sort of grapes

steps: Lay the semi-ripe grapes in a crock; crush half a pound of the same sort of grapes; strain the juice and mix with {{source-2}} and pour over the whole berries, which stand covered for 2 days, then place the whole over fire and cook until the grapes have changed color, whereupon they are taken out and placed in the crock.
Cook the juice a little longer, skim and pour hot over the grapes, which are covered with a cloth and left for another 2 days.

Then place the whole over fire again; when it begins to cook, take out the grapes and place in the crock; cook the juice well, skim and pour hot over the grapes, which are covered with a cloth and tied the next day.

After they have stood for 8 days, the juice may have become thin; it is then cooked with an addition of 2 ounces sugar per pound and poured cold over the grapes, which are covered with paper dipped in brandy and tied.
They can also be preserved in the same way with powdered sugar, and are then good for cakes, sweet soup and sauces.

title: Enfoldig Kyllingesalte (Simple Boiled Chicken)
description: Prepared with chicken, water, and salt.
steps: This method is far preferable to any other.
The chicken is soaked in cold water for 12 hours; after that it is washed very well and the skin is scrubbed with a stiff brush.
Place it in the steamer, cover with a lid and set it over a stove with boiling water.
Cook approximately 22 minutes per pound.
The water is kept at a steady boil.
When the chicken is served warm, it is cut and a layer of bread crumbs is placed over it to prevent the juices from running out.

title: Eylet (Crab-Apple)
description: Prepared with crab, lemon juice, and sugar.
steps: Select small, red crab apples for this. The stems remain on, and they are placed in preserving liquid with enough distilled water to cover them.
Bring to boil and cook slowly until the skin cracks; then strain, cool and peel them; with a small knife pit them through the end where the blossom sits.
Weigh them; for one pound of fruit take 1.5 pounds sugar and a small cup of water.
Water and sugar are cooked and properly skimmed; then add the fruit and cook gently under cover until the apples are clear, red and tender.
Then take them out with a fork and spread on dishes to cool and become firm.
To the syrup add the juice of one lemon for every three pounds of fruit, and cook until it is thick and clear.
Fill the glasses or crocks three-quarters full with fruit, pour syrup over, and tie when cold.

title: Fersken Gele (Peach Jelly)
description: Prepared with peach, peaches, and lemon juice.
steps: Blanch the fruit, cut it into pieces and remove the stones. Cut one-third of the kernels into pieces and put them in the pot with the fruit. Heat the sugar as usual, and proceed according to the instructions. This jelly gives an exquisite flavor in cakes.

title: Fine Omelet of Eggs
description: Prepared with eggs, onion or veal stock, and cornstarch.

ingredients.name: Half an onion or veal stock
ingredients.sourceText: Half an onion or veal stock

steps: A white sauce is prepared as follows: half an onion or veal stock is cut in strips and added together with some parsley in a quart of cold water, boiled and skimmed until the meat is cooked in pieces and half the soup has boiled away. Then it is carefully strained and returned to the pot with half a cup of milk. When it boils, thicken it with a tablespoon of cornstarch, stirred in a little cold milk, season with white pepper, salt, and the juice of half a lemon. Set aside in the oven and keep warm. Six, eight or ten eggs are boiled hard, the yolks carefully removed and the whites cut into thin strips. The yolks are now piled up in the middle of a deep dish, and the strips are arranged around it so it takes the form of a bird's nest; stir in the sauce and pour it carefully over the eggs. The sauce should go halfway up the nest. Garnish with parsley.

title: Fiskekompot (Fish Compote)
description: Prepared with fish, onion, and carrots.
steps: Cut the fish into pieces and cook in 4 quarts water with salt, a large onion and carrots

Cook the fish completely, press it through a sieve and strain it

If you do not have a stove, you can stir a few tablespoons of vinegar into the lukewarm preparation

description: A soup made with carrot, parsnip, and onion.

ingredients.name: Half a head of endive salad leaves
ingredients.sourceText: Half a head of endive salad leaves

ingredients.name: Several slices of cold cooked beets
ingredients.sourceText: Several slices of cold cooked beets

steps: Prepare fillets as for filet (see that recipe), cut a carrot, a parsnip and an onion; make a fish broth
Place these vegetables over the stove in 1.5 quarts cold water together with the fish and {{source-5}}, and bring the whole to a boil
Then remove the fillet carefully, lay it between two kitchen towels to cool, and let the soup cook gently

Cut half a head of endive salad leaves into small pieces with an instrument, such as a knife or vegetable cutter, and briefly place in boiling, well salted water, then dry and lay in cold water until needed
Some slices of cold cooked beets are formed like the salad and handled in the same way; keep all of this aside until it is needed
Rub the rest of the fillet through a strainer with a pestle
Place 1 quart milk over the stove to boil; place {{source-9}} over the stove at the side and stir in an equal amount of flour

Gradually add this mixture with the boiling milk and with a quart of the water in which the vegetables were cooked; season the soup with a little white pepper and some nutmeg, and if needed with a little more salt; stir in the ground fish and season the soup slowly with a whipped egg
When the soup is ready to serve, add fish, salad and beets, and serve at once so that the contrasting colors do not fade

title: Fluffisk (Fish Soufflé)
description: Prepared with fish, nutmeg or ginger, and egg yolk.
steps: Make a roux by melting a good piece of butter and stirring flour into it little by little until it has a suitable consistency
Add the fish and grated nutmeg or ginger
Cook it a little, then add a small piece of sugar and salt
Bind the fish with an egg yolk, which gives it a good flavor
Layer slices of French bread that have first been baked in butter on a pan, and pour the fish over

Alternatively, place the warm fluffisk in a deep pan, sprinkle a layer of soft bread made from a finger-spoonful over it, pour melted butter over it and set it in the oven where it should bake light brown
If the bread is to sink down into the fish, this should be fairly thick and is therefore better bound with two egg yolks
Alternatively, one can use boiled fish or cooked red fish, though the latter should be chopped fine and requires much butter
If one does not wish to use bread for the salted fish, small-cut cooked carrots and ginger can be added

title: Frugt Gele (Jellies)
description: Prepared with fruit and sugar.
steps: Put the fruit in a stone pot; set this in a pot with lukewarm water and set a cover over it. Let it cook with a closely fitting lid until the fruit is soft. If you do not have a fruit press, which is the easiest, press the fruit through a coarse sieve very hard, only putting in a few handfuls at a time. For each pint of juice take 1 pound of sugar. The juice alone is set over heat and while it heats the sugar is divided into several parts and added gradually. Place a pot in the oven, which should not be too hot; from time to time open the door and stir the sugar to prevent it from burning. When the juice has come to a boil let it cook for 20 minutes and skim if necessary. The sugar should be so hot that you cannot put your hand in it. Should it melt around the edges it is no harm, though it is better to avoid; the melted parts will only form into lumps in the syrup and can easily be removed. Once the sugar is added to the boiling syrup, while stirring very quickly; it will melt quickly. As soon as you are quite sure the sugar is melted, remove the spoon. Then let the juice just come to a boil and immediately take the pot from the fire. Roll the glasses in hot water and fill with boiling jelly. Tie it up the next day.

title: Gele af Crab-Æbler (Crab-Apple Jelly)
description: Prepared with crab, water, and sugar.
steps: Cut sour, unripe crab apples into pieces, but do not peel them. Neither do you remove the kernels. These last give a special fine aroma to the jelly. Put the fruit in a stone pot, which is set in a pot of hot water, and let it cook 8 to 9 hours. If the apples are very dry, take a cup of water for every 6 pounds of fruit. When it is cooked let it stand in the pot half the night. Next morning press out all the juice, and prepare the jelly in the usual manner, giving 1 pound of sugar for each pint of juice. Crab-apple jelly is considered one of the finest, both in appearance and in taste.

title: Handchokolade på Pariser Manier (Hand Chocolate, Parisian Style)
description: Prepared with chocolate, cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Grate the chocolate and dissolve it in 1 pint of cream
Place it in a high pot, set over gentle heat and cook
When it has cooked for 10 minutes, whisk it with an egg whisk until it froths strongly and pour it little by little into 2 egg yolks that are whisked throughout the entire work
Place it back in the pot and whisk continuously with the egg whisk
All the formed foam is transferred with a skimming spoon into pre-warmed cups, and this is continued until it stands piled up in the form of a dome over the cups
A tablespoon that is made glowing hot is held quite close over the foam until a kind of crust forms, after which the chocolate is served.

This chocolate froths even better when some sugar is stirred into the egg yolks, or also when foam birds are used, which are prepared in the following way: a sufficient number of egg whites are whisked to very stiff foam, and into it is stirred so much fine powdered sugar that the mass forms a stiff dough. This is spread on a baking sheet, and when it is about to dry, small birds are formed from it, of the size of a medium nut, which are then dried completely in the sun or by room heat. After the egg yolks in the above manner are whisked together with the chocolate, a foam bird is placed in the chocolate for each cup and whisked for a long time over the fire until all the chocolate mass is dissolved into almost a foam. One must observe the precaution that the chocolate is only warmed until nearly boiling; it must not boil at all.

title: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Sauce
description: A sauce made with eggs, tongue or game, and melted butter.

ingredients.name: Sauce from game or veal stock
ingredients.sourceText: Sauce from game or veal stock

steps: Hard-boiled eggs (cooked 10 minutes) are cut in half and the yolk is removed; it is finely mixed with a little chopped tongue or game bird, a little parsley, a little melted butter and quite a little mustard. This is stirred well together and with it the egg whites are filled, which are placed close together in a deep dish with sauce, the open ends facing up. Now some sauce from game stock or veal stock is prepared; this is brought just to boiling with half a tablespoon of chopped parsley, salt, pepper and finally three spoonfuls of cream. When it boils up, it is poured over the eggs, the dish is covered, it stands for five minutes, and is then sent to the table. As soon as the hard-boiled eggs are ready, place them in cold water, so the yolk does not become dark.
